reviews.comment: Hopefully my first and last D. Clicks for some people and doesn't for others (me). Such a sweet woman though I love her so much I would retake this class with her.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Acct 229 is the 'dreaded' class, but it was doable with Barrett! Her lecture and write-out-note style and examples were great. Must go to class for notes (or help desk). Use the practice exams to study, and prev. work & notes. Also be sure to have desk check over the 1 group project(she allows). Keep on top of practicing. Didn't read textbook.

I loved Barrett. She took difficult concepts and made them incredibly easy to understand. The tests were tough, but if you start studying early you'll be fine. I went to maybe 3 or 4 SI sessions, but I stopped after the first two weeks or so. I also didn't read the textbook. Everything on the tests is covered in the lectures.

Barrett does a great job teaching this class, BUT GO TO MAYSTUTORS. Only reason why I succeeded and everyone didn't. They teach you how to be successful in class and get an A. Everyone says to go to SI and Tutor John, but Maystutors is cheaper and teaches much better then both of those tutoring services. Check them out Definitely worth every buck!

Really good professor and easy to follow in lectures! She is really accessible and you can ask her questions before/during/after the lecture. One group project that you pick your group for (make sure to at least know someone) Grades are based heavily on tests and no curve until the very end only if needed. DO THE HW AND EXTRA PRACTICE TO DO WELL!!

Mrs. Barrett is one of the best professors I've ever had. This is a challenging course and you need to put in efforts to earn an A. There are plenty of resources to help you succeed. Go to SI sessions! People who consistently go to SI sessions do way better than others. She also provides a lot of review materials to help you prepare for the exams.

Barrett is an amazing person and professor. She is very knowledgeable and really cares about her students. The class is well organized, with rigid lecture structures followed. This is a difficult class, but if you put in the work (going to SI sessions, doing practice problems, going to lectures) you can get an A. Overall, Barrett is awesome!

Difficult class for sure, but possible to get an A. 80% of the grades were from the tests, unfortunately. The professor teaches quite well and I have a lot of respect for her. I couldn't imagine getting even a B without studying, so be ready, but that doesn't take away from her lectures, just implies that the material is unique and hard.

Mrs. Barret truly cares about the students and tries to make VERY difficult concepts easier to understand. I would recommend reading the textbook chapters BEFORE coming to class, if not it is much harder to follow along. Overall, great teacher and very sweet lady...also have to calculate your current grade as she does not reveal it in Canvas.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Barrett sparked my love for accounting and actually made it interesting to learn. When students were confused she would relate it to real world examples and explain the material in a way that makes sense. She is the best professor and I would take her class again any day! Take a professor that cares about you and that is Barrett

Mrs Barrett is an awesome professor! Accounting 229 can be one of the hardest classes in Mays for some and I think she does a great job lecturing all the material. She goes through absolutely everything that will be on the test in her lectures. If you do all the quizzes and work through all the extra practice problems, you can easily succeed.

Professor Barrett taught the material very well each lecture. Put time and effort into using the resources provided (office hours, quizzes, additional problems, practice exams, help desk, extra credit, etc)! Spending extra money on a tutor is not necessary. The class is challenging, but there are plenty of resources to help you be successful.

No lie, its a hard class. She is the best Acct Prof. The grading criteria is just tough in general, so it is a really hard A. The group project is an easy 100 and all the quizzes are 100s. Exams are tough, so make sure you study for them.

Professor Barrett is one of the most caring professors I've had at Mays so far. ACCT 229 is boring and hard, and she understands that and encourages us to use as many resources as we can to do well in her class. Buy ACCT229com and watch the videos ahead of class and you'll do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is hard, but no where near as bad as everyone says. Barrett is very knowledgable and kind. An A is definitely possible in this class as long as you go to class, pay attention, and study periodically. Make sure you understand the concepts and not just the formulas. If you get behind on any material get back on track ASAP. You can do this!

ACCT 229 is a hard class, but I would recommend taking Barrett. She is so nice and sets you up for success. I would definitely recommend going to SI sessions for extra practice. The class is graded on a group project, 3 exams, Quizzes, and a Final. The final exam was the easiest of them all. Don't let this class intimidate you! Barrett is the best!
ACCT 229 is a hard class no matter who you take but I would definitely recommend taking Barrett. Really nice and helpful and very knowledgable on the class since she has been doing it for so long.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor. Hard class. Knowledgable, passionate, and sweet professor. The content is just hard and the class has to move at a very fast pace. Keep up! Don't fall behind or you'll never be able to catch up. Do the extra problems and tutoring. It will pay off in the end! Overall, sweet prof but a challenging class.

This class can be hard, but don't let what other people say intimidate you. The first test is the easiest and then gradually gets harder. Stay on top of watching the lecture videos and work all of the extra problems and practice test. I recommend going to all the SI sessions and get some extra help from tutoring, this is how I made an A.

Professor Barrett is great! The class content is very difficult and a lot of people tend to blame their poor scores on the prof. Professor Barrett had great lecture videos and provided lots of resources to use for practice. You need to watch the videos or go to lectures to do well in this class there is no avoiding that. Take her if you have chance
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I do not recommend taking Mrs. Barrett for ACCT 229 if you have her online. All she posted were youtube videos filling out the notes. She didn't have class zoom calls or in person options, but every other teacher did. There were no homework assignments. No feedback about class averages on tests. This class was the reason why I did not get a 4.0.

I love Professor Barrett! She is such a sweet lady who truly wants her students to succeed! Acct 229 is a difficult course in general, but she does a great job explaining things in her lectures and is very engaging. She is so willing to help! It is definitely a lot of work, but an A is achievable with effort and Barrett's great teaching!

Professor Barrett was great at teaching ACCT 229 and is very friendly! Overall, ACCT 229 is difficult; however, professor Barrett did a good job in explaining the material during lecture. To be successful, I recommend going to the help desk for quizzes and going to SI sessions.

Mrs. Barrett is one of the best choices for ACCT 229. The class itself is hard and there is a ton of material that is covered. She does go over topics very rapidly and does not always give the most thorough explanations due to the amount of material. She does write half of the exam, so her insights can be helpful. She truly cared about her students

I really enjoyed the class and the Professor Barrett a lot. The class itself is very difficult for everyone, but it is important to study a lot and attend SI sessions. Really liked that she posted blank notes for the entire semester on the first day of class because it allowed me to make all the notes into a spiral and use for the whole semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mrs. Barrett is a phenomenal teacher, but ACCT 229 IS HARD. She explains things as best as she can, but there is so much material that she cannot go as in depth as I would have liked. She does write half of the ACCT 229 Exams. Barrett is a solid choice for this rough class.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Acct 229 was a difficult class, but by going to every lecture and listening to Barrett's exam advice, it was very manageable. I put about 3 hours learning every chapter well enough to do the quiz, and 14 to prepare for the exam, including the helpful optional review. Barrett was really nice, it's just a hard class no matter who you take it with.

Act 229 is the hardest class I've taken so far at A&M but Barrett was a good prof. she went a little fast but I found that going to 4.0 and go was extremely helpful. Barrett understands her class is difficult and is happy to answer any questions you might have.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: ACCT 229 is a very tough class, there's no getting around it. Barrett is a great teacher in my opinion, and gives solid guided notes that are very useful for the quizzes and exams. My only complaint with her is that she often goes so fast that it's hard to keep up with what she's writing and saying. Tests are killer, no matter how much you study.

Mrs. Barrett was a really good teacher. ACCT 229 is a hard class as it is, but she gives you notes to follow along in class, extra practice problems, non-graded book problems, and quizzes to bump your grade. The only thing I didn't do that probably would have allowed me to make an A would have been to read the textbook for the theoretical concepts.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: ACCT 229 was super difficult, Barrett knew what she was doing and you learned a lot in class but the exams might as well have been in a foreign language. You will do all kinds of examples and review questions that are all similar, and then the exam is completely different. Good luck.

I highly recommend taking Barrett for ACCT229. Everyone complains about how terrible this class is, but it is not impossible. Stay on top of learning and the second you feel behind catch up. I also highly recommend going to tutor john. However Barrett is awesome, her lectures are engaging and she is a very experienced teacher.

Barrett keeps the material simple. Many students talk this class up to be something it is not. Plane and simple this class is exactly what it is advertised to be, an introduction to financial accounting. Barrett makes the learning easy. The tests were all moderately difficult.

Take Barrett! I had her for an 8 am and it was WELL worth it! Barrett wants you to pass and genuinely cares about her students! She's like a your mom for ACCT. I would suggest getting the textbook - just to start you off I read chapters 1 -4. She creates half of the exam (which all 229 students take) - which makes her lectures very valuable!

Take Barrett! She makes ACCT 229 totally doable. Print off the notes and follow along with her in class. It's not an easy class, but she is great at explaining things in a way that makes sense. She's really friendly and loves getting to know her students. Definitely wouldn't skip class bc you learn a lot of new stuff every day. Overall, great prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Accounting 229 is known to be hard at A&M but I feel like she did a great job teaching this course. She is always willing to reexplain something and does not go too fast. Here is the deal, if you attend each class and pay attention and study good a week in advance for the EXAM'S then you will pass with an A.P.S. DO NOT TAKE PROF HEAD FOR THIS CLASS
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Barrett is a solid prof who really cares about ACCT and that you understand. She's very good at explaining and is one of my favorite teachers I've had. She's very helpful when you have questions, and wants you to succeed. The class does have a group project. Would encourage using the help desk if needed. Hard class but can work for a B or an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Barrett was by far one of my favorite professors this spring. ACCT 229 at Tamu is HARD, period. I'm fairly certain her classes had the highest averages among all the 229 professors this spring.  She is very enthusiastic and very nice.  The test are hard as f. I made a 57.5 on the first test but still managed a B. Study hard and dont give up.

Prof. Barrett was a nice lady, but wasn't a very good teacher. Whenever I asked questions, she almost grudgingly answered them, and she wasn't very good at explaining things.  She assumes that you understand everything she's taught after just one pass through the material. I had to go to Tutor John to really learn the concepts covered in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Barrett is SO wonderful. She explains difficult concepts extremely well. I was able to get an A in the class by doing all of the quizzes, additional problems, and textbook problems along with lecture and then re-working all of them before each test. Practice is really the only way to study. Go to the Sunday reviews.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mediocre at teaching, at best. Sometimes it seems as if she taught herself the material the night before she tries to teach us. Exams are fairly difficult as well. Take this class at a community college if you can.

I've heard all of the accounting teachers are pretty similar, so any choice would be a good choice. Barrett is very sweet though and is definitely there for you if you have any questions. You have to study a ton for the tests, no doubt about it. And that's whether you want an A or just want to pass. I think she is a very solid choice though!

Professor Barrett is one of my favorite professors. She is a very nice lady and is willing to help if you just ask. There was a group project that was done via excel, its not too bad though. She gets your tests grader and back in a timely manner. ACCT 229 isn't the easiest class, but she tries to break it down and make it a little easier.

Mrs. Barrett is a very sweet professor and definitely tries her best to make sure you are understanding the material. That being said, Accounting 229 itself is not a very easy class and you have to work for your grade. The tests are very long and if you don't study, there is no way you will pass. However, making an A is definitely possible.

Mrs. Barrett is awesome! She explains the material clearly and only tests on stuff that she has gone over in class. This class has a bad reputation but if you go to class and pay attention and do outside homework you will do great!!!
Best professor ever!!

This is one of the hardest classes business majors have to take. There are 4 tests, including a cumulative final, quizzes, and a group project. The exams are hard, and she only curved the final. She knows what she's talking about, but she has a hard time understanding that her students have never seen the material before.
Mrs. Barrett is great! She goes at a nice pace explaining the material and is very thorough. Takes a lot of studying, but tests are fair.

This class is not an easy A but getting an A is definitely possible. Take advantage of the practice problems on her website and the help desk when it comes to quizzes and work outside of class. If you put in the time and go to class you will get a good grade
The course is hard but she is a good prof that will work with you. Definately better than the other options
She's ok.
